digest.component_or_area: agent guidance and tool workflow (Serena / LSP integration)
propositions: Agents default to using bash grep for source-code reference lookups instead of Serena's symbol tools despite documented preference, due to friction asymmetry (grep is already in-hand; symbol tools require discovery round-trip)
Serena's LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), making it incomplete without grep as a fallback
The symbol-tools guidance in AGENTS.md loses salience over time during multi-turn stories and has no runtime trigger or violation detection
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits (line-number drift) and grep produces false positives in comments that the LSP filters; neither tool alone is sufficient

Three independent fixes needed: (1) PreToolUse hook on bash grep to re-surface Serena at action time, (2) project-specific criterion and coaching move to detect and redirect incomplete reference enumerations, (3) disable ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH to eliminate discovery friction for symbol tools in this repo
